title: compliance_rule
description: One node/edge-set in the compliance graph: a checkable rule linking a WCAG SC to components, an automated check, severity and legal source.

applies_to.description: component categories or specific components this rule governs — the CLAIMED edge (asserted by the component metas, not machine-checked).

verified_by.description: The VERIFIED edge — orthogonal to applies_to. Null means this rule has no executable check wired into the build yet (applies_to is asserted only). Non-null means an executable, gating-or-advisory check runs in knowledge/_build_all.py and its current result is recorded here. Populated by knowledge/compliance/_build_verification_edges.py, which runs AFTER the audits/gates it reads (contrast audits, a11y gate) so the result reflects the current build, not a stale claim. Granularity note: today's mechanisms check at TOKEN or SNIPPET granularity, not always at the exact per-component-instance granularity applies_to implies — see 'granularity' field.

script.description: generator/validator that produces the evidence, relative to knowledge/

artifact.description: report file the result was read from, relative to knowledge/

mechanism.description: one line: what is actually being checked and how

granularity.description: component = checked per named component instance (e.g. per snippet); token = checked on the design-token store, joined to components only via blast-radius (not yet a direct per-component edge); aggregate = one pass/fail for the whole rule, not split by component

result.description: pass = 0 non-allowlisted failures against this SC at the last build run

checked.description: ISO date this verified_by entry was last (re)computed
